title: Key West Dolphin Watch and Sunset Sail on Catamaran
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Aboard our spacious 42-foot sailing catamaran, you'll experience the pure joy of sailing as the lightweight boat glides across the water, catching every gust of wind. This tour is perfect for all ages and offers a wide-open, unobstructed view of the surrounding seascape.
We will search for our resident Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins and then head to the best seat in the house to witness a world-famous Key West sunset. Watch as the sky erupts in a spectacle of color from the peaceful vantage point of the water.
Organic fruit and filtered water will be provided to keep you refreshed, and you're welcome to bring your own adult beverages to toast to a successful day. 
Join us for a relaxing and memorable evening that celebrates the serenity of sailing, the wonder of marine life, and the breathtaking beauty of a Key West sunset.
